# Spec — checkout modal

WHY: The ticket points at a screen.
WHO: Checkout shopper.

## REQ-001

When the shopper confirms payment, then the system shows the modal from Figma screen `203:13054`.
Origin: Jira SHOP-12 description.
Expected outcome: modal visible.

## Out of scope
